scripts.db:reset: docker exec dc-postgis psql -U dc -d dc -q -c "DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE; CREATE SCHEMA public;" && docker exec dc-postgis psql -U dc -d dc -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -f /db/schema.sql
scripts.db:test: npm run db:reset && docker exec dc-postgis psql -U dc -d dc -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -f /db/smoke_test.sql
scripts.db:pull: prisma db pull && node prisma/postpull.mjs && prisma format && prisma generate
scripts.db:seed: docker exec dc-postgis psql -U dc -d dc -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -f /db/seed_demo.sql
scripts.db:seed:cases: docker exec dc-postgis psql -U dc -d dc -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -f /db/seed_cases.sql
